change: Removed the 43 MB saved web page, the committed .git backup, 40 unused UI primitives and 3 unrendered components
URL routing with React Router: one route per page, NotFound, menu generated from the page list

One hand-written stylesheet with dark mode replaces 58 KB of pre-compiled utilities
Video gallery, blog and feed evolved; instant messaging and search added; one storage path; API address setting
Strict TypeScript in every build; matching type packages; 43 unused packages and 40 import aliases removed
API server: salted password hashes; only the signed-in author can delete a post
Relative asset paths, page metadata, cross-platform deploy script
README and ARCHITECTURE rewritten; this Readme page, diagrams, metrics and tests
New visual theme: charcoal + electric blue in plain Calibri; diagrams recoloured to match; font packages reduced from three to one
ESLint, Prettier and Vitest tooling; whole codebase formatted

Personas, scenarios and user stories traced to every feature
Unit and component tests with Vitest and coverage thresholds
